1.storyline: As of Nov 2026, Ninjas in Pyjamas enter Stage 1 as Seed 1 on a VRS invite (1,564 points), fielding sjuush, xKacpersky, stavn, Krimbo and adamb under coach Xizt. They open on Nov 24 against M80 in a best-of-one.

12.storyline: As of Nov 2026, Natus Vincere start in Stage 2 on a VRS invite (1,589 points). The lineup is Aleksib, iM, b1t, w0nderful and makazze, coached by B1ad3, with academy player FAZERY registered as substitute. 60.name: Astralis
60.headline: Astralis skip Stage 1 with Anlelele standing in
60.storyline: As of Nov 2026, Astralis begin in Stage 2 on a VRS invite (1,572 points) with Staehr, phzy, ryu and siuhy plus Anlelele, on loan from Sashi as their registered substitute, coached by NEO. Anlelele fills in because cmtry, signed on a short loan from FUT in October, stayed on FUT's VRS roster and could not play the Major; Astralis confirmed his exit on Nov 17, a day after jabbi left at the end of his contract. On Oct 4 they beat Nemiga 3-1 to win Stake Ranked Episode 4, the club's first LAN trophy since 2019. FUT and Nemiga are also in Stage 2.

78.headline: 100 Thieves are Major debutants after winning FiRe Last Chance
78.storyline: As of Nov 2026, 100 Thieves took the last European Major spot by winning FiRe Last Chance 2026 without dropping a map, beating Wildcard 2-0 in the Nov 1 grand final. On Nov 17 they also won the PGL Cluj-Napoca 2027 closed qualifier, beating fnatic 2-1 in the final.

132.name: FlyQuest
132.headline: FlyQuest return with aliStair, open against Eternal Fire
132.storyline: FlyQuest are a Stage 1 invite from Asia and open against Eternal Fire on Nov 24. The Oceanic side re-signed aliStair on Sept 2 as AWPer and in-game leader, rejoining INS, Vexite, nettik and jks under coach AZR. As of Nov 2026 they won the DFRAG Invitational, beating Alter Ego 3-0 in the Nov 1 final, two weeks after losing the DFRAG Logitech G Pro Series final to NEXVOID. At the Cologne Major in June they beat Liquid to reach Stage 2, where their run ended.

134.name: Aurora
134.headline: Cologne Major semi-finalists Aurora jump in at Stage 3
134.storyline: Aurora skip to Stage 3 as a European invite. After going 3rd-4th at the IEM Cologne Major 2026, losing the semi-final to FURIA, they rebuilt in July: MAJ3R stepped down, Jimpphat and kyxsan joined XANTARES, Wicadia and woxic, and ash took over as coach. The new roster took second at StarSeries Fall and third at ESL Pro League S24 and the Thunderpick World Championship, but went 5th-8th at PGL Masters Bucharest and 9th-12th at IEM Beijing. As of Nov 2026, ash told HLTV that expectations "rose too quickly" inside the team.

140.name: M80
140.headline: Three straight Stage 2 exits; Singapore opens against NiP
140.storyline: M80 (slaxz-, Swisher, s1n, JBa, Lake, coach dephh) enter at Stage 1 and open on Nov 24 in a best-of-one against Ninjas in Pyjamas. HLTV ranks them #24 as of Nov 17, and they went out in Stage 2 at each of the last three Majors, most recently 1-3 in Cologne after a loss to Legacy. Recent form is mixed: they stunned NAVI at BLAST Open Porto in August but lost to FURIA and Aurora to exit in the groups, won Roman Imperium Cup VIII in September, then went 0-2 against Spirit, MOUZ and BetBoom at ESL Pro League S24 in October.

145.name: FUT
145.headline: PGL Bucharest champs and EWC finalists, now cooling off
145.storyline: FUT won PGL Bucharest in April (3-1 over Astralis, cmtry MVP) and reached the Esports World Cup grand final, losing 1-3 to Spirit on Aug 23. As of Nov 2026 HLTV ranks them #9 and lists them as the top European Stage 2 seed (Nov 28), but they arrive on a three-series losing streak: 5th-8th at PGL Masters Bucharest and 7th-8th at BLAST Rivals S2, where coach coolio stood in for the visa-hit Krabeni. cmtry, back from a three-week loan to Astralis, is still on FUT's Major roster, so FUT start the Major with registered substitute SunPayus in his place alongside xfl0ud, dem0n, Krabeni and dziugss.
